properties.l: ("2024-09-26 12:03:00-05",T,,"1 SE Ehrhardt",Bamberg,SC,"NWS Storm Survey","A short lived tornado ahead of Hurricane Helene touched down near Gabriel Road in northern Colleton County with a few tree limbs down and a tree snapped at the trunk.
